summary: [¶] Petition under Section 79 of the Electricity Act, 2003, seeking approval of Serentica Renewables India Private Limited’s applications dated 16.10.2025 submitted for change of source in terms of Regulation 9.3 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022, as amended from time to time and consequential relief thereto. [¶] The present Petition has been filed by Serentica Renewables India Private Limited (SRIPL), seeking appropriate direction(s) to CTUIL to approve SRIPL’s application dated 16.10.2025 seeking change of source, in terms of Regulation 9.3 of the CERC (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022, as amended (“GNA Regulations”). [¶] - (c) _Pass such other order(s) as this Hon’ble Commission may consider deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case_ . [¶] **4.** The matter was called for a hearing on 19.05.2026. During the course of the hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner, SRIPL, while submitting that the Respondent, CTUIL, has already allowed the Petitioner’s change of source application, sought liberty to file an affidavit to place on record the said development along with permission to withdraw the present Petition as it had become infructuous. Considering the above, the Commission permitted the Petitioner to file its affidavit thereof, and subject thereto, the matter was reserved for order. [¶] **Order in Petition Number 227/MP/2026** [¶] **5.** Petitioner vide affidavit dated 22.05.2026 has submitted that subsequent to the filing of the Petition, the Respondent, Central Transmission Utility of India Ltd. (CTUIL) vide its letter dated 30.04.2026, had approved the Petitioner's change of source application dated 16.10.2025. Since the change in fuel source application has been approved by CTUIL, the present Petition has become infructuous. Accordingly, the Petitioner, without prejudice to its rights and remedies available under law, seeks leave to withdraw the present Petition. [¶] **7.** Petition No. 227/MP/2026 is disposed of in terms of the above.
